issues.description: Constructor signature for UniqueTable differs between the template and the solution. In the template (dd.py) UniqueTable.__init__ is defined to take a 'size' parameter, but the module later instantiates UT = UniqueTable() with no argument. The solution defines UniqueTable.__init__ with no parameters. This mismatch in the template will cause a runtime TypeError when importing dd.py and will block students from running or testing their code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor signature consistent. Update the template's UniqueTable.__init__ to take no parameters (def __init__(self) -> None:) so that UT = UniqueTable() works, matching the solution. Alternatively, if a 'size' argument is intended, change the UT = UniqueTable() instantiation to provide an explicit size and document its meaning. The simplest fix preserving educational intent is to remove the unused 'size' parameter from the template constructor.
